description: This PHP class 'Store' in the 'Opencart' admin controller handles generating and clearing JSON files related to store configurations for an OpenCart-based system. It includes methods for creating store JSON files for different languages and clearing certain stored JSON files.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store JSON files in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates JSON files for each language containing store information, creating directories if necessary.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes existing store JSON files for all configured languages.
